g.text: MVC; serves public + team views; calls Auth/ReleaseGate; TLS-only.
Enforces PUBLIC/TEAM_ONLY classification filters and release transitions (ASR-005/NFR-002).
NFR-001: strong auth, lockout, TLS, audit 180d.
Central error taxonomy, retries, alerts, SLO metrics (ASR-006/NFR-003/NFR-004).
Local NAS/object store for telemetry, intermediate, IDFS (ASR-004).
assumption: "MetadataCatalog DB" stores classification labels and release records used by ReleaseGate.
